selection.rule: At least +0.25 DSR percentage points vs initial, descriptive paired 95% lower bound >0, no fixed-parent mean below -0.25 points, and nonnegative point contrast vs matching decomposition. Prefer short when both qualify but correct relative labels do not separate from short and shuffled.
selection.scope: Pilot development selection only; no confirmatory claim or formal-test access.

scope: Arithmetic/provenance self-review. No new Torch inference, scenarios, physical rollout, trained-model selection or optimizer training.
